name: RockawayX
decision_note: Prague-headquartered crypto/Web3 venture investor (formerly Rockaway Blockchain Fund) that closed its USD 125m VC II in Q1 2025 and led or co-led rounds in Silhouette (2025) and OnRe (2026).

evidence.quote: We invest in early-stage projects, then build alongside them.

The fund achieves its mandate by pursuing opportunities in the full spectrum of blockchain assets, with a focus on the Solana ecosystem and decentralized finance (DeFi) and infrastructure protocols where RockawayX is a primary liquidity provider or provided custom hardware support.

24 April 2025 – RockawayX, a global $2bn aum digital asset investment firm, today announced the launch of its second early-stage venture capital fund, closed in Q125 at $125 million, following an oversubscribed fundraising period.
RockawayX – původně fungovalo pod značkou Rockaway Blockchain Fund – oznámilo, že do svého druhého fondu nasbíralo dalších 125 milionů dolarů, tedy 2,75 miliardy korun.
That’s why we’re thrilled to be leading Silhouette’s $3 million pre‑seed round, alongside Hivemind, Amber Group, NGC, No Limit Holding, and Protagonist.
The two firms co-led OnRe's $5 million Series A round.
The Fund allocates capital to venture equity, pre-launch token projects, liquid tokens, and early stage funds that present niche and complementary expertise.

analyst_notes: Discovered via CzechCrunch (2025-04-28, VC II close). Classification caveat: RockawayX is a multi-strategy digital-asset firm (~USD 2bn AUM) that also runs liquid/market-neutral crypto funds, vault curation and validator infrastructure (E3-type activities); it is recorded as vc because its VC I/VC II funds back early-stage companies and protocols, but VC II also buys pre-launch and liquid tokens (e7). Sector mapped from 'Solana ecosystem, DeFi and infrastructure protocols' to fintech/software_saas (no crypto sector in the closed list). Capital = VC II size (USD 125m, closed Q1 2025, announced 2025-04-24); firm-wide AUM USD 2bn not used. Group context: RockawayX was Rockaway Capital's crypto division (CzechCrunch reports a 2025 sale agreement with Nasdaq-listed Solmate that later collapsed); Rockaway Ventures is a separate brand covered by another analyst. Legal: RockawayX a.s. and RockawayX Holding a.s. (statutory body Viktor Fischer, Praha 6); website operator Blockad s.r.o.; VC fund vehicles' jurisdiction not stated (the market-neutral fund is a Liechtenstein SICAV, the liquid fund is Cayman). OnRe described as Bermuda-licensed; Silhouette country not stated. Ticket not disclosed (led a USD 3m pre-seed, co-led a USD 5m Series A).
